newsitem.title: FRANCE: S&P puts Banque Indosuez on positive credit watch.
newsitem.headline: S&P puts Banque Indosuez on positive credit watch.

text.p: Rating agency Standard & Poor's said it was putting Banque Indosuez on credit watch with positive implications following the acquisition of the bank by Credit Agricole.
Credit Agricole on Saturday agreed to buy the 49 percent in Indosuez it did not yet own from Cie Financiere de Suez.
Indosuez has a long-term A+ rating and a short term A-1 rating.
Under an initial plan Credit Agricole would have obtained another 29 percent in 1997 and the last 20 percent in 2000.
"The speeding up of the deal means an acceleration of the integration of Banque Indosuez within Credit Agricole, which has an AA/A-1+ rating," S&P said in a statement.
